articles.summary: SES AI Corporation (“SES AI”) (NYSE: SES), a global leader in the development and manufacturing of AI-enhanced high-performance Li-Metal and Li-ion batteries, today announced its schedule for January appearances and activities. CES Date: January 6-9, 2026 Location: Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC) To schedule a meeting during CES 2026, please contact: Angel.Chan@ses.ai or shana.tischler@ses.ai Gordon Research Conference (Electrochemistry) Date: January 6, 2026 Location: Ventura, California Event Details: Dr. Kang Xu, CTO, will present on Material Discovery for Electrolytes in the AI Era. 28th Annual Needham Growth Conference Date: January 16, 2026 Location: Virtual Time: 8:00 a.m. ET Event Details: Dr. Qichao Hu, Founder and CEO, will make a presentation on SES AI’s latest developments in Drone Battery, ESS (Energy Storage Systems), and Materials, and conduct investor meetings throughout the day.
